description.zh: 备份时间，24小时制整点时间。取值：1~24。
description.en: The backup time in 24-hour format. Valid values: 1 to 24.

description.zh: 自动备份周期，单位天数。 取值为1、3、7、30。
description.en: The automatic backup interval, in days. Valid values: 1, 3, 7, and 30.

description.zh: 手动备份更新为自动备份的镜像ID列表。
description.en: A list of image IDs to change from manual backup to automatic backup.

description.zh: 自动备份更新为手动备份的镜像ID列表。
description.en: A list of image IDs to change from automatic backup to manual backup.

descriptions.zh: 仅支持中国内地密码机实例备份调用。
descriptions.en: This operation applies only to backup tasks for Hardware Security Module (HSM) instances in the Chinese mainland.
